Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL1123890. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return columns chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Order by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
